__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

count.description: Number of ancillary items in the banner-worthy state. Zero when state is `None`.

toAdd.description: Items missing from the requisition that need to be added. Always populated from the underlying plan, regardless of `state` — the client can show the full breakdown even when the banner-relevant state is `NeedsUpdate`.

toUpdate.description: Items present on the requisition with stale quantities.
